name: iter_vary_architecture
description: Single-axis: MODEL ARCHITECTURE. Everything else at the paper's operating point, accumulative regime only, 8 iterations, 10 seeds, one detector so the architecture is the only thing moving. The single-round study held one MLP shape fixed; under repetition capacity decides how much of the old input space a round of continued training can preserve while absorbing the weak region, so this maps the guided-vs-random gap and the out-of-weakspot drift against width, depth and a bottleneck. n_model_params is recorded on every row as the capacity covariate.
